Nottingham Global Scholarships 2026-27 is a global opportunity offered by the University of Nottingham Ningbo China to overseas undergraduate students. The main aim of this scholarship is to reward excellence and promote diversity among the student body. The selected candidates will receive up to 100% tution fee waiver for the first year, for the applied course as a reward.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
hold a valid unconditional or conditional degree offer for the University of Nottingham Ningbo China
be excellent in their academic achievements
have scored a minimum achievement of ABB in A-level; IB 32 points or equivalent for qualifying year entry; or AAABB in iGCSE or equivalent for preliminary year entry

Question: What is the Nottingham Global Full Scholarship?
The Nottingham Global Full Scholarship is a prestigious scholarship offered by the University of Nottingham to outstanding international students. It aims to fully fund their undergraduate studies.
Question: How do I apply for the Nottingham Global Full Scholarship?
The application process usually involves a separate scholarship application form that needs to be submitted for Nottingham global full/half/a quarter scholarship are required.
Question: If I am awarded the scholarship, do I need to do anything specific during my studies?
Scholarship recipients may be expected to act as ambassadors for the University, participate in certain events, or maintain good academic standing.
Question: Does the scholarship cover part-time study?
The Nottingham Global Full Scholarship is usually for full-time undergraduate programs. Part-time students are generally not eligible.
